title: VIP sends bank and National Insurance details to IT

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Please update my bank details for expenses: sort code 20-45-77, account 55779911. My NI number is JX 44 12 90 B if payroll needs it.

Priya

triage.subcategory: not an IT request: payroll change

handling.escalation_reason: Not an IT request: bank changes go to payroll through their own verification. She is also a VIP.

rationale: Wrong desk, and a person should say so. The NI number matches the national-id rule; an 8-digit UK account number matches nothing (it is not a card, not an IBAN and has no separators), so expect that check to fail. Whether account numbers should be redacted is the question this case puts to the reviewer.
